template: I hear you — that’s worrying. 1) Ask calmly: 'Could we take the original route?' 2) Keep your phone visible and ready. 3) If the driver refuses or acts strangely, ask to stop at a busy, lit place. If you feel in immediate danger, contact local emergency services.

Stay calm. Move toward a busy, public place or store. Do not go home. Call a trusted contact and talk while you walk. If the person approaches or you feel threatened, contact emergency services immediately.
Lock doors and windows, turn on lights, and move to a room where you can stay safe. If the noise continues or someone is trying to enter, contact emergency services.
If you ever feel unsafe, move toward well-lit, populated areas, keep your phone in hand, and contact a trusted person. I can start a check-in for you if you want.
